headline: 4 token contracts catalogued (USDu and sUSDu on Solana and BSC); no control, multisig or staking-contract addresses found.

findings.text: Explorer name-tag search was not completed. Direct fetches of the bscscan.com token pages (checksummed URLs taken from the docs) failed, and the bscscan address, solscan and defipunkd read-API fetches were rejected by the tool allowlist or the fetch budget. A web search found third-party aggregators listing the same USDu addresses, but no explorer-tagged page.

The official docs overview (docs.unitas.so) has a table of 4 official token addresses: USDu and sUSDu on Solana, and USDu and sUSDu on BSC. The docs show no other contracts, such as the staking contract, the cooldown/withdrawal contract, the minting program, the Guardian Council multisig, or vault multisigs.
The audit repo UnipayFI/Audit was fetched. Its README lists EVM, SVM and UP-token audit PDFs, but the individual PDFs were not opened, so no in-scope address tables were extracted.

No source-code repo is recorded for the protocol. The only recorded GitHub link is the audit-reports repo, which has no deployment artifacts. The docs link a GitHub org (github.com/Unipayfi), but it was not fetched.
Both chains (Binance/BSC and Solana) have the USDu and sUSDu token addresses from the docs. No admin, multisig or timelock address was surfaced on either chain.
No factory contracts were identified, so there were no children to enumerate.

All 4 catalogued addresses are classified role=token with actor_class=unknown, because bytecode and owner were not read. The docs mention a Guardian Council (5/9 multisig) with emergency powers, but give no address.
Every address in admin_addresses traces to the fetched docs overview page. The BSC token addresses are in lowercase there, and the explorer links use checksummed forms.

rationale.verdict: Discovery walked the Unitas docs overview and the audit-repo README, and catalogued 4 token addresses across Solana and BSC. Explorer verification failed and no control-surface addresses were found.

evidence.shows: Official docs overview with a table of official token addresses: USDu (Solana 9ckR7pPPvyPadACDTzLwK2ZAEeUJ3qGSnzPs8bVaHrSy), sUSDu (Solana 9iq5Q33RSiz1WcupHAQKbHBZkpn92UxBG2HfPWAZhMCa), USDu (BSC 0xea953ea6634d55dac6697c436b1e81a679db5882), sUSDu (BSC 0x385c279445581a186a4182a5503094ebb652ec71). It also says launch chains are Solana and BSC, names a Guardian Council (5/9 multisig, emergency powers), says Unipay DAO governance is not yet active (decisions are made by Unipay Labs), and links the docs/GitHub org/email.

Audit-reports repo README (main branch, no commit SHA pinned) listing EVM, SVM and UP-token audit PDFs. It names ScaleBit, Oak Security and SlowMist as audit firms, and says the UP token audit by ScaleBit is dated August 19, 2026.
Website probe returned only page metadata and title ('Unitas Solana', 'Decentralized Stablecoin Protocol on Solana'), with no body content or addresses.

unknowns: D1: bscscan.com name-tag search and address pages were not fetched. The token page URLs taken from the docs returned 'could not be accessed', and the bscscan address URL was rejected by the allowlist. Owner, proxy and implementation of the BSC USDu and sUSDu tokens are unread.

D1-offchain: Solscan fetch for the USDu mint (https://solscan.io/token/9ckR7pPPvyPadACDTzLwK2ZAEeUJ3qGSnzPs8bVaHrSy) was not completed because the tool-call budget was exhausted. Mint authority, freeze authority and update authority are unread. The Solana program IDs (minting/staking/redeem) are unknown.
D1-offchain: The defipunkd /api/contract/read call for BSC USDu (method=owner) was rejected by the allowlist because the address was not pinned in the context. No on-chain reads were performed.

D2: The docs overview lists only token addresses. A dedicated deployments page, the staking contract, the 7-day cooldown/withdrawal contract, the whitelist/minting program, and Guardian Council and vault multisig addresses were not found. Docs say multisig addresses are on the 'transparency dashboard' (sol.unitas.so was referenced in search results), which was not fetched.
D3: None of the audit PDFs in UnipayFI/Audit (EVM/SVM/UP folders) were opened, so no in-scope address tables were extracted. They would likely list the staking, minting and cooldown contracts.

D4: No source-code repo is recorded (protocol.github is none). The docs-linked org github.com/Unipayfi was not fetched, so no deployment artifacts (broadcast, deployments/*.json) were checked and no commit SHA was pinned.
D5: chain Solana: only the token mints from docs surfaced. No program IDs, multisigs or vault addresses surfaced from the sources tried (docs, audit-repo README, web search).
D5: chain Binance: only the 2 token addresses from docs surfaced. No admin, multisig or staking contract addresses surfaced from the sources tried.
D6: no factory contracts identified, so no children were enumerated.

D8: The Solana mints also appear in third-party search snippets (Solflare, RWA.xyz, CoinPaprika). An Ethereum USDU deployment 0xdde3ec717f220fc6a29d6a4be73f91da5b718e55 appeared in a pharos.watch search snippet, labelled 'USDU Finance', which may be a different project. It was not fetched, so it is not recorded in admin_addresses. RWA.xyz also lists an Ethereum ERC-20 USDU ending in 718e55, which may be the same contract, but this is unverified.
D8: Docs say on-chain collateral (JLP) is held in multisig wallets and off-chain in Ceffu/Copper custody. No multisig or Safe address was found.

protocol_metadata.about: Unitas issues USDu, an overcollateralized soft-pegged dollar stablecoin, on Solana and BSC. Per the docs, whitelisted participants mint and redeem USDu against collateral that backs delta-neutral strategies, and regular users acquire it on secondary markets. Staking USDu mints sUSDu, a savings token whose exchange rate rises as protocol revenue (funding rates, fees, JLP fee carry) is redistributed. Unstaking enters a 7-day cooldown.
